node.title: L1 cofactor-prefix Pade graph normal form
node.statement: For an exact shell with w=a-k, forced cofactor degree 0<=e<k, and d=w+e, reverse the high coefficients. The product equations are Qhat(T)Lhat(T)=Uhat(T) mod T^(d+1). As Qhat ranges over its q^e choices with fixed nonzero constant term, Lhat=Uhat/Qhat gives a q^e-point codimension-w polynomial graph in depth-d locator-prefix space; projection to the first e locator coefficients is bijective and recovers Qhat by Uhat/Lhat mod T^(e+1). Exact shell members are exactly the split degree-a locators whose prefixes meet this graph and whose recovered cofactors satisfy the complement gcd guard. The graph has ambient density q^(-w). No divisor/graph transversality, quotient payment, or e>=k bound is asserted.
